## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Security and privacy checklist

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private keys, `.env` contents, or production/customer data are included.
- [ ] New or changed permissions/scopes are documented and use least privilege.
- [ ] Agent-facing external content is treated as untrusted data rather than instructions.
- [ ] This change does not introduce Jira/data mutation, or the mutation is intentional and clearly documented.
- [ ] Dependencies are pinned or reproducible where practical.
- [ ] Relevant validation/lint/tests pass.

## Testing

Describe the checks you ran and their results.
